# Screen-print poster — Style Prompt

> A poster printed on camera, one flat ink per pull. A squeegee drags an ink bead across a screen frame, back and forth; each pull lays one opaque colour with a ragged leading edge, stepped bands stand in for gradients, and layers sit a pixel or two off register so slivers of bare paper show. The dark information band is printed last, item by item, left to right.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

A sheet of paper on a wooden workbench, seen from above, being printed in front of the viewer. Every colour is an opaque ink laid by its own pull; a later ink covers an earlier one completely. There are no gradients, no halftone, no line work: a shape's edge is where one flat ink stops. Skies and haze are **stepped bands** (a flat colour, then stripes that thin out, then the next colour).

What makes it silkscreen and not flat vector art: **registration** (every ink offset 1–3 px, so a crescent of paper shows between inks), **ink rim** (a faint light edge top-left, dark edge bottom-right, fills only), and **paper** (cream stock with fibre grain and pinholes in the paper colour, visible only on ink).

Not two-ink print (translucent fluorescent overprint with halftone grain), not woodcut (carved line), not low-poly. Opaque, line-free, flat, banded.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **One SVG layer per ink**, all the same size, stacked; each is revealed by a `clip-path` polygon whose front edge is ragged (a ~30 px drag tail with seeded noise). One CSS variable (`--f`, the front position) drives the polygon and the squeegee together, linear, no easing.
- **Squeegee**: wooden handle, dark rubber blade, then a round ink bead ahead of the blade (lit half, mid, dark underside) tinted with the ink being pulled. It alternates direction every pull and lies across the whole sheet. Hide it between pulls.
- **Screen frame**: a thick aluminium ring around the sheet at the start, lifting toward the camera (scale up, move up, then gone) once the last ink is down.
- **Sheet**: paper colour, 28 px border, a soft drop shadow, a paper-grain overlay drawn once from a seeded PRNG and kept as an image. Table: planks with grain lines and a few muted stains, drawn once; masking-tape corners mark the sheet.
- **Shapes**: concentric sun rings (disc, then two thin rings in the same ink), smooth far hills, nearer hills or a built object in a darker ink, and a near-ink silhouette (a crowd, trees, rooftops) along the foot. Generate silhouettes from a seeded PRNG; do not hand-list shapes.
- **Poster template**: art area on top, a dark info band at the foot with a big name, a rule, and a row of small label + value stats.
- Keep texture light: more grain reads as two-ink print.

## 3. Colour logic

- **Six inks per poster**, by role: light sky, upper sky (the main brand colour), sun, far hills, middle plane, near (darkest, also the info band). The brand's signal colour becomes `--utama` (upper sky and the pull bead), its second colour `--aksen` (far hills); the near ink and band text come from `--teks` and `--latar`, so the poster still reads under any brand.
- **Values step from far (light) to near (dark)**; depth is value, never blur.
- **A re-ink changes inks, not geometry**: the night palette mixes `--aksen` into `--teks`.
- **Paper is a colour**: unprinted paper is the brightest thing on the sheet.
- **Fixed, not the brand's**: the wood table, the aluminium frame, the squeegee wood and rubber, the tape.
- Text colours follow the ink beneath: `--teks-di-utama` for the title on the upper sky, `--latar` on the near-ink band.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul`: a condensed display face (Bebas Neue). Title 130–170 px at 1920 wide, a secondary line 46–64 px tracked out 0.16–0.2em; band headlines 60–105 px; stat values 40–48 px.
- `--font-isi`: a geometric sans (Poppins 500) for letter-spaced labels, 15–22 px, tracked 0.18–0.2em, in capitals.
- Titles are printed into the sky, the band last. The poster text is the subtitle: no floating captions.
- Each text holds at least chars/12 + 1 s (minimum 1.5 s) after it lands.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Pulls are linear and steady**: a squeegee does not ease. 0.45–0.9 s per pull; the next pull starts 0.05 s after the last ends, in the opposite direction.
- **Info items** print left to right in 0.3 s wipes staggered 0.14 s. There is no fade anywhere: things are printed, lifted or slid.
- **Screen lift**: scale 1 → 1.3 and up 50 px in 0.5 s, power2.in.
- **Sheet change**: the old sheet slides out upward in 0.55 s power2.in while the new one rises from below, power3.out.
- **Re-ink**: one wide pull in 0.5 s; then the layers snap from ±7 px off register to zero in 0.12 s power4.out.
- **Camera**: a slow truck of ±50 px over the printing; a push to the band of 1 → 1.2 in 1.4 s power2.inOut.
- Final hold ≥ 2 s with nothing moving.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | Expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Truck with the squeegee, ±50 px, the frame edge in view | the act of printing, colour arriving | a hook; the first poster |
| Locked top-down full sheet | layers stacking into a picture | a build; a comparison |
| Frame lifts toward the camera | a layer set is complete | a title reveal |
| Push to the info band (1 → 1.2, origin low) | reading | facts; a date; a price |
| Sheet slide (out up, in from below) | the next poster | a series; a change of topic |
| Wide re-ink sweep | the same thing in another palette | a variant; day to night; a season |
| Hold on the finished sheet under tape | the poster in the world | the final lockup |

No dissolves, no bare cuts.

## 7. Native moves

- **One ink, one pull.** Facts are printed last, when they are read. *Fits content like:* a gig's date and door time; a clinic's opening hours; a class schedule; a story's chapter list.
- **Stepped-band sky with concentric sun.** The light source as the one round motif. *Fits content like:* a festival's golden hour; a sunrise run; a bakery's morning menu; a travel guide.
- **Silhouette foot.** A near-ink crowd, trees or rooftops along the bottom that merge into the info band. *Fits content like:* a concert's audience; a village market; a hiking trail; a school fair.
- **Registration slip → snap.** Loose layers clamp into place on one hit before the key facts. *Fits content like:* a launch date; a race start; a ticket sale opening.
- **Re-ink.** One sweep turns the poster into another palette. *Fits content like:* day and night programme; summer and rainy-season hours; colourways of a product.
- **The info band.** Name, rule, three small stats. *Fits content like:* a trail's distance and time; a workshop's place, price and time; a creator's upload days.

## 8. Pitfalls

- A stroked edge draws internal lines on unioned shapes: fills only.
- A full-rectangle shadow under the frame muddies the print: the frame is a ring, so its shadow stays outside.
- A gradient anywhere breaks the look: use stepped stripes.
- Parallax alone reads as moving mountains: keep the paper gaps, then snap to zero on a hit.
- Many hand-listed shapes blow the file size: generate crowds, hills and stripes from a seeded PRNG.
- Text on the dark band is the paper colour, never a brand accent.
- Too many items at honest reading times overrun the length: print items side by side in one wipe, or let secondary ones be read on the final sheet.

# Screen-print poster: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 2.8, long 4.

## hook

- en: a screen frame over bare paper; the squeegee drags one flat ink per pull, back and forth, building the poster before the frame lifts away
- id: bingkai sablon di atas kertas kosong; rakel menarik satu tinta datar tiap tarikan, bolak-balik, sampai poster jadi lalu bingkai diangkat

## problem

- en: the same poster printed with a slipped registration: layers off by a few pixels, bare paper slivers showing, until one hit snaps it true
- id: poster yang sama dicetak dengan registrasi meleset: lapisan geser beberapa piksel, celah kertas terlihat, sampai satu sentakan meluruskannya

## fact

- en: a new sheet slides in; its dark info band is printed last and the camera pushes down to it while items print left to right
- id: lembar baru meluncur masuk; pita info gelapnya dicetak terakhir dan kamera mendorong ke pita itu saat item dicetak kiri ke kanan

## step

- en: one pull per step, alternating direction, each step a new flat ink on the same print; later ink covers earlier ink completely
- id: satu tarikan tiap langkah, arah bergantian, tiap langkah satu tinta datar baru di cetakan yang sama; tinta baru menutup yang lama

## compare

- en: two palettes of one geometry: a wide squeegee sweeps over the sheet and only the inks change from one side of the blade to the other
- id: dua palet satu geometri: rakel lebar menyapu lembar dan hanya tintanya yang berganti dari satu sisi bilah ke sisi lain

## number

- en: the figure is printed last in a tall condensed face on the dark band, with its label above it; the camera pushes in and holds
- id: angka dicetak paling akhir dengan huruf kondens tinggi di pita gelap, labelnya di atas; kamera mendorong masuk lalu diam

## proof

- en: a finished print hung under tape corners on the table; a thin ink rim and paper grain show the hand-pulled quality, held still
- id: cetakan jadi menempel dengan sudut selotip di meja; tepi tinta tipis dan serat kertas memperlihatkan hasil tarikan tangan, ditahan diam

## offer

- en: the price and the call are printed into the dark band, item by item left to right, after the layers snap into register
- id: harga dan ajakan dicetak ke pita gelap, item demi item kiri ke kanan, setelah lapisan menyentak masuk register

## cta

- en: the poster is re-inked, the layers clamp into register on one hit, then contact details print and the sheet holds still for 2 s or more
- id: poster dicetak ulang, lapisan menyentak masuk register dalam satu hentakan, lalu kontak dicetak dan lembar diam 2 detik lebih

## payoff

- en: the finished sheet on the table under its tape corners, ink rim and grain showing; nothing moves for the last 2 s or more
- id: lembar jadi di meja dengan sudut selotip, tepi tinta dan serat kelihatan; tidak ada yang bergerak selama 2 detik terakhir atau lebih

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Poster sablon</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Bebas Neue"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #f2e8d2; --latar-2: #e6d6b0; --utama: #e4683f; --aksen: #2f6f73;
        --teks: #1c2a33; --teks-redup: #4a5a60; --teks-di-utama: #1c2a33; --teks-di-aksen: #f2e8d2;
        --utama-di-latar: #b84a25; --aksen-di-latar: #2f6f73;
        --font-judul: "Bebas Neue", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Poppins", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Enam tinta sablon, diturunkan dari token: langit terang, langit atas, matahari, bukit jauh, tengah, dekat. */
        --i-sky1: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 22%, #f7d58a); --i-sky2: var(--utama);
        --i-sun: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 30%, #fbe3a6); --i-far: var(--aksen);
        --i-mid: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 62%, var(--teks)); --i-near: var(--teks);
        /* Bahan bengkel, tetap di semua brand: meja kayu, bingkai aluminium, tangkai, bilah karet. */
        --kayu: #5e4432; --kayu-alur: #3f2c21; --alu: #b8bab4; --tangkai: #c48a52; --bilah: #23201e;
        --tape: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 70%, var(--kayu));
      }
      /* Cetak ulang malam: geometri sama, hanya tinta yang berganti. */
      .malam {
        --f: -300px;
        --i-sky1: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 50%, var(--teks)); --i-sky2: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 22%, var(--teks));
        --i-far: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 34%, var(--teks)); --i-mid: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 16%, var(--teks));
      }
      html, body { margin: 0; background: var(--kayu); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--kayu); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .table, .scene { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; }
      .poster { position: absolute; background: var(--latar); box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38); }
      .poster > * { position: absolute; }
      .grain { left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
      .ink { --f: -300px; }
      .k0 path { fill: var(--i-sky1); } .k1 path { fill: var(--i-sky2); } .k2 path { fill: var(--i-sun); }
      .k3 path { fill: var(--i-far); } .k4 path { fill: var(--i-mid); } .k5 path { fill: var(--i-near); }
      .k5 .st { fill: none; stroke: var(--i-near); stroke-linecap: round; }
      .k5 rect { fill: var(--i-near); }
      .k6 text { font-family: var(--font-judul); fill: var(--teks-di-utama); text-anchor: middle; }
      .k6 .lt { font-family: var(--font-isi); font-weight: 500; fill: var(--latar); letter-spacing: 0.18em; }
      /* Pita info di kaki poster: dicetak terakhir, per item dari kiri ke kanan. */
      .band { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 34px; box-sizing: border-box; color: var(--latar); }
      .band .r1 { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; }
      .band b, .band i { font: 400 var(--a) / 1 var(--font-judul); font-style: normal; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
      .band .hr { height: 3px; background: var(--latar); margin: 14px 0 16px; }
      .band .r2 { display: flex; gap: 44px; }
      .band u { display: block; text-decoration: none; font: 500 var(--l) / 1 var(--font-isi); letter-spacing: 0.2em; opacity: 0.7; margin-bottom: 8px; }
      .band em { font: 400 var(--c) / 1 var(--font-judul); font-style: normal; }
      .it { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); }
      /* Rakel: tangkai, bilah karet, lalu manik tinta di depan bilah (ujung kanan = sisi depan). */
      .sq { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 170px; visibility: hidden; transform-origin: 100% 50%; }
      .sq > * { position: absolute; }
      .hd { left: 0; width: 124px; top: 30px; bottom: 30px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 18px, rgba(90, 50, 20, 0.18) 18px 20px), var(--tangkai); box-shadow: 8px 10px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); }
      .bl { left: 124px; width: 12px; top: 0; bottom: 0; background: var(--bilah); box-shadow: 8px 10px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); }
      .bd { left: 136px; width: 34px; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; border-radius: 17px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--bead) 76%, black) 0 28%, var(--bead) 28% 62%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--bead) 70%, white) 62% 78%, var(--bead) 78%); }
      .frame { position: absolute; border: 46px solid var(--alu); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); box-sizing: content-box; }
      .tp { position: absolute; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-top: 9px solid var(--tape); border-left: 9px solid var(--tape); box-sizing: border-box; transform-origin: 0 0; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <div class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook"></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s2" data-role="fact"></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s3" data-role="cta"></div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const gs = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
      const tok = (n) => gs.getPropertyValue(n).trim();
      // PRNG berbenih: semua tekstur dan keramaian sama di tiap render.
      const mul = (s) => () => { s |= 0; s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 1 | s); t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
      const mk = (tag, cls, par, css) => { const e = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) e.className = cls; if (css) e.style.cssText = css; if (par) par.appendChild(e); return e; };
      // Kanvas dilukis sekali lalu jadi gambar biasa (dirasterisasi sekali).
      function bitmap(w, h, fn, cls, par) {
        const c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = w; c.height = h; fn(c.getContext("2d"), w, h);
        const img = mk("img", cls, par); Object.assign(img, { src: c["toDataURL"]("image/png") }); return img;
      }
      function wood(g, w, h) {
        const r = mul(3), n = 7, ph = h / n;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          g.fillStyle = tok("--kayu"); g.fillRect(0, i * ph, w, ph);
          g.fillStyle = i % 2 ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.07)"; g.fillRect(0, i * ph, w, ph);
          g.strokeStyle = tok("--kayu-alur"); g.globalAlpha = 0.3; g.lineWidth = 1;
          for (let k = 0; k < 26; k++) {
            const y = i * ph + 4 + r() * (ph - 8), a = r() * 5; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, y);
            for (let x = 0; x <= w; x += 60) g.lineTo(x, y + Math.sin(x * 0.01 + a) * 2.2); g.stroke();
          }
          g.globalAlpha = 1; g.fillStyle = tok("--kayu-alur"); g.fillRect(0, i * ph, w, 3);
        }
        g.fillStyle = "rgba(125,135,95,0.5)"; // noda cat di meja
        for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(120 + r() * 700, 60 + r() * 420, 26 + r() * 18, 16 + r() * 10, r() * 3, 0, 7); g.fill(); }
      }
      // Serat kertas dan lubang jarum: hanya terlihat di atas tinta.
      function grain(g, w, h) {
        const r = mul(9);
        for (let k = 0; k < 26; k++) {
          const x = r() * w, y = r() * h, q = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, 60 + r() * 80);
          q.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0.05)"); q.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)"); g.fillStyle = q; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
        }
        for (let k = 0; k < w * h * 0.012; k++) { g.fillStyle = r() < 0.6 ? "rgba(0,0,0,0.08)" : tok("--latar"); g.fillRect(r() * w, r() * h, 1.4, 1.4); }
      }
      // Bukit: dua sinus berfase acak, ditutup ke dasar.
      function ridge(aw, yb, amp, f, bot, seed) {
        const r = mul(seed), p1 = r() * 6, p2 = r() * 6; let d = `M0 ${bot}`;
        for (let x = 0; x <= aw + 24; x += 24) d += `L${x} ${(yb + amp * (Math.sin(x * f + p1) * 0.6 + Math.sin(x * f * 2.3 + p2) * 0.4)).toFixed(1)}`;
        return d + `L${aw} ${bot}z`;
      }
      const circ = (x, y, r) => `M${x - r} ${y}a${r} ${r} 0 1 0 ${2 * r} 0a${r} ${r} 0 1 0 ${-2 * r} 0z`;
      // Langit bertingkat (pengganti gradasi): garis makin tipis ke bawah.
      function steps(aw, y0, y1, n) { let d = ""; const c = (y1 - y0) / n; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) d += `M0 ${y0 + c * i}H${aw}v${c * (1 - (i + 0.5) / n) * 0.95 + 1.2}H0z`; return d; }
      // Penonton: kepala, bahu, dan tangan terangkat sebagai siluet satu tinta.
      function crowd(aw, ah, sc, seed) {
        const r = mul(seed); let d = "", a = "";
        for (let x = -10; x < aw + 30; x += 34 * sc * (0.8 + r() * 0.5)) {
          const y = ah - 26 * sc + (r() - 0.5) * 30 * sc, hr = (15 + r() * 6) * sc;
          d += circ(x, y, hr) + `M${x - 34 * sc} ${ah + 80}Q${x - 34 * sc} ${y + hr + 6 * sc} ${x} ${y + hr + 4 * sc}T${x + 34 * sc} ${ah + 80}z`;
          if (r() < 0.3) { const s = r() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1, ex = x + s * (14 + r() * 22) * sc, ey = y - (40 + r() * 34) * sc; a += `M${x + s * 16 * sc} ${y + 22 * sc}L${ex} ${ey}`; d += circ(ex, ey, 7 * sc); }
        }
        return `<path d="${d}"/><path class="st" d="${a}" stroke-width="${8 * sc}"/>`;
      }
      // Enam tinta seni (langit terang, langit atas, matahari, jauh, tengah, dekat + pita).
      function art(aw, ah, ih, o) {
        const sx = o.sx * aw, sy = ah * 0.7, sr = ah * o.sr, st = o.stage;
        const ring = (k0, k1) => `<path fill-rule="evenodd" d="${circ(sx, sy, sr * k0)}${circ(sx, sy, sr * k1)}"/>`;
        let mid = `<path d="${ridge(aw, ah * 0.86, ah * 0.05, 0.012, ah, 5)}"/>`;
        if (st) { // panggung: atap rangka, dua tiang, dua tumpukan speaker, lampu
          const cx = aw / 2, y = ah * 0.52;
          mid = `<path d="M${cx - 230} ${y}h460v22h-460z M${cx - 205} ${y}h18v${ah * 0.26}h-18z M${cx + 187} ${y}h18v${ah * 0.26}h-18z M${cx - 215} ${ah * 0.76}h430v${ah}h-430z M${cx - 262} ${ah * 0.76 - 112}h54v112h-54z M${cx + 208} ${ah * 0.76 - 112}h54v112h-54z"/>`;
          for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) mid += `<path d="${circ(cx - 160 + k * 80, y + 36, 9)}"/>`;
        }
        return [
          `<path d="M0 0H${aw}V${ah}H0z"/>`,
          `<path d="M0 0H${aw}V${ah * 0.44}H0z${steps(aw, ah * 0.44, ah * 0.68, 5)}"/>`,
          `<path d="${circ(sx, sy, sr)}"/>${ring(1.2, 1.3)}${ring(1.45, 1.52)}`,
          `<path d="${ridge(aw, ah * 0.76, ah * 0.07, 0.008, ah, 2)}"/>`,
          mid,
          `${crowd(aw, ah, o.sc, 4)}<rect x="0" y="${ah}" width="${aw}" height="${ih - ah}"/>`,
        ];
      }
      const sceneCoords = {};
      function poster(sc, x, y, pw, ph, c) {
        const b = 28, aw = pw - 2 * b, ih = ph - 2 * b, ah = c.ah, L = art(aw, ah, ih, c.o);
        const svg = (k, d) => `<svg class="ink k${k}" viewBox="0 0 ${aw} ${ih}" width="${aw}" height="${ih}" style="left:${b}px;top:${b}px">${d}</svg>`;
        const el = mk("div", "poster" + (c.cls || ""), sc, `left:${x}px;top:${y}px;width:${pw}px;height:${ph}px`);
        el.innerHTML = L.map((d, i) => svg(i, d)).join("") + (c.title ? svg(6, c.title) : "")
          + (c.band ? `<div class="band" style="left:${b}px;top:${b + ah}px;width:${aw}px;height:${ih - ah}px;${c.bs}">${c.band}</div>` : "");
        bitmap(pw >> 1, ph >> 1, grain, "grain", el);
        const r = mul(c.seed), inks = [...el.querySelectorAll(".ink")];
        inks.forEach((k) => gsap.set(k, { x: (r() - 0.5) * c.reg, y: (r() - 0.5) * c.reg })); // registrasi sedikit meleset
        return { el, inks, items: [...el.querySelectorAll(".it")], ox: x + b, oy: y + b, aw, ih };
      }
      // Sudut selotip di meja.
      function tape(sc, x, y, w, h) {

        const el = mk("div", "poster" + (c.cls || ""), sc, `left:${x}px;top:${y}px;width:${pw}px;height:${ph}px`);
        el.innerHTML = L.map((d, i) => svg(i, d)).join("") + (c.title ? svg(6, c.title) : "")
          + (c.band ? `<div class="band" style="left:${b}px;top:${b + ah}px;width:${aw}px;height:${ih - ah}px;${c.bs}">${c.band}</div>` : "");
        bitmap(pw >> 1, ph >> 1, grain, "grain", el);
        const r = mul(c.seed), inks = [...el.querySelectorAll(".ink")];
        inks.forEach((k) => gsap.set(k, { x: (r() - 0.5) * c.reg, y: (r() - 0.5) * c.reg })); // registrasi sedikit meleset
        return { el, inks, items: [...el.querySelectorAll(".it")], ox: x + b, oy: y + b, aw, ih };
      }
      // Sudut selotip di meja.
      function tape(sc, x, y, w, h) {
        [[0, 0, 1, 1], [w, 0, -1, 1], [0, h, 1, -1], [w, h, -1, -1]].forEach(([dx, dy, sx, sy]) => mk("i", "tp", sc, `left:${x + dx}px;top:${y + dy}px;transform:scale(${sx},${sy}) translate(-30px,-30px)`));
      }
      function squeegee(sc, len) {
        const q = mk("div", "sq", sc, `height:${len}px`); mk("div", "hd", q); mk("div", "bl", q); mk("div", "bd", q); return q;
      }

      const root = document.getElementById("root");
      root.prepend(bitmap(540, 960, wood, "table"));
      const S1 = document.getElementById("s1"), S2 = document.getElementById("s2"), S3 = document.getElementById("s3");
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

      // Satu tarikan rakel: klip bergerigi digerakkan lewat satu variabel --f, rakel mengikuti garis depannya.
      // Arah r, l, d, u; el = tinta (atau seluruh poster) yang terbuka di belakang rakel.
      function pull(sq, el, ox, oy, w, h, dir, t0, dur, col, f0) {
        const hz = dir === "r" || dir === "l", al = hz ? w : h, ac = hz ? h : w, T = 30, flip = dir === "l" || dir === "u";
        const r = mul(Math.round(t0 * 97) + 3), far = flip ? al + 80 : -80, pts = [];
        const P = (d, s) => (hz ? `${d} ${s}px` : `${s}px ${d}`);
        pts.push(P(`${far}px`, -8));
        for (let s = -8; s <= ac + 8; s += 18) {
          const t = T * (r() * 0.65 + r() * 0.35); pts.push(P(flip ? `calc(${al + t}px - var(--f))` : `calc(var(--f) - ${t}px)`, s));
        }
        pts.push(P(`${far}px`, ac + 8));
        el.style.clipPath = `polygon(${pts.join(",")})`;
        const a = f0 ?? -T, b = al + T, H = ac + 90;
        gsap.set(el, { "--f": `${a}px` });
        const X = (f) => (hz ? (dir === "r" ? ox + f : ox + al - f) : ox + ac / 2) - 170;
        const Y = (f) => (hz ? oy + ac / 2 : dir === "d" ? oy + f : oy + al - f) - H / 2;
        const st = { autoAlpha: 1, rotation: { r: 0, l: 180, d: 90, u: -90 }[dir], "--bead": col };
        if (t0 === 0) gsap.set(sq, { ...st, x: X(a), y: Y(a) }); // kadar pertama sudah tampil di detik 0
        tl.set(sq, st, t0);
        tl.fromTo(sq, { x: X(a), y: Y(a) }, { x: X(b), y: Y(b), duration: dur, ease: "none", immediateRender: false }, t0);
        tl.fromTo(el, { "--f": `${a}px` }, { "--f": `${b}px`, duration: dur, ease: "none", immediateRender: false }, t0);
        tl.set(sq, { autoAlpha: 0 }, t0 + dur);
      }
      // Rangkaian tarikan satu poster: [tinta, arah, mulai, lama, warna].
      const run = (sq, P, seq, f0) => seq.forEach(([i, dir, t0, dur, col], n) => pull(sq, P.inks[i], P.ox, P.oy, P.aw, P.ih, dir, t0, dur, col, n ? undefined : f0));
      const print = (P, t0) => tl.fromTo(P.items, { clipPath: "inset(0 100% 0 0)" }, { clipPath: "inset(0 -2% 0 0)", duration: 0.3, ease: "none", stagger: 0.14, immediateRender: false }, t0);
      const C = ["--i-sky1", "--i-sky2", "--i-sun", "--i-far", "--i-mid", "--i-near", "--i-sky2"].map((n) => `var(${n})`);

      // ===== 1. hook: spanduk dicetak di bawah bingkai sablon, tujuh tarikan bolak-balik (tegak: atas-bawah) =====
      tape(S1, 70, 200, 940, 1240);
      const P1 = poster(S1, 70, 200, 940, 1240, {
        ah: 1080, o: { sx: 0.68, sr: 0.12, sc: 0.8, stage: 0 }, seed: 12, reg: 3,
        title: `<text x="442" y="210" font-size="168">RAWA KUNING</text><text x="442" y="290" font-size="64" style="letter-spacing:.2em">REUNI SENJA</text>`
          + `<text class="lt" x="442" y="1124" font-size="28">SABTU 14 DES 2026 ·</text><text class="lt" x="442" y="1164" font-size="28">LAPANGAN GANG MAWAR · RP25RB</text>`,
      });
      const fr = mk("div", "frame", S1, "left:24px;top:154px;width:940px;height:1240px");
      const q1 = squeegee(S1, 974);
      run(q1, P1, [[0, "d", 0, 0.9, C[0]], [1, "u", 0.95, 0.55, C[1]], [2, "d", 1.55, 0.45, C[2]], [3, "u", 2.05, 0.55, C[3]], [4, "d", 2.65, 0.5, C[4]], [5, "u", 3.2, 0.6, C[5]], [6, "d", 3.85, 0.55, C[1]]], 260);
      tl.fromTo(S1, { x: 30 }, { x: -30, duration: 4.6, ease: "none" }, 0);
      tl.to(fr, { scale: 1.3, y: -50, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in", immediateRender: false }, 4.5).set(fr, { autoAlpha: 0 }, 5.0);
      gsap.set([S2, S3], { y: 2000 });
      tl.to(S1, { y: -2000, duration: 0.55, ease: "power2.in" }, 5.55);

      // ===== 2. fact: poster tegak naik dari bawah, pita info dicetak lalu kamera mendorong ke pita =====
      const bandStats = (rows) => `<div class="r1"><b class="it">${rows[0]}</b><i class="it">${rows[1]}</i></div><div class="hr it"></div><div class="r2">`
        + rows[2].map(([u, e]) => `<div class="it"><u>${u}</u><em>${e}</em></div>`).join("") + `</div>`;
      tape(S2, 90, 150, 900, 1380);
      const P2 = poster(S2, 90, 150, 900, 1380, {
        ah: 900, o: { sx: 0.5, sr: 0.13, sc: 1.1, stage: 1 }, seed: 21, reg: 3, bs: "--a:80px;--c:60px;--l:24px",
        title: `<text x="422" y="240" font-size="160">SATU MALAM</text><text x="422" y="326" font-size="56" style="letter-spacing:.16em">LIMA PERSONEL LAGI</text>`,
        band: bandStats(["SABTU 14 DES", "19.00", [["TEMPAT", "GANG MAWAR"], ["TIKET", "RP25RB"], ["PINTU", "18.00"]]]),
      });
      const q2 = squeegee(S2, 934);
      tl.to(S2, { y: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: "power3.out", immediateRender: false }, 5.65);
      run(q2, P2, [[0, "d", 6.55, 0.5, C[0]], [1, "u", 7.1, 0.45, C[1]], [2, "d", 7.6, 0.35, C[2]], [3, "u", 8.0, 0.4, C[3]], [4, "d", 8.45, 0.4, C[4]], [5, "u", 8.9, 0.55, C[5]], [6, "d", 9.5, 0.45, C[1]]]);
      print(P2, 10.0);
      tl.fromTo(S2, { scale: 1 }, { scale: 1.2, transformOrigin: "50% 76%", duration: 1.4, ease: "power2.inOut", immediateRender: false }, 9.4);
      tl.to(S2, { y: -2000, duration: 0.55, ease: "power2.in" }, 10.95);

      // ===== 3. cta: poster siang dicetak ulang malam dengan satu rakel lebar, lapisan menyentak masuk register (tegak: ditarik ke bawah) =====
      tape(S3, 70, 200, 940, 1300);
      const wide = { ah: 640, o: { sx: 0.78, sr: 0.15, sc: 0.8, stage: 0 }, reg: 3 };
      poster(S3, 70, 200, 940, 1300, { ...wide, seed: 31 });
      const P3 = poster(S3, 70, 200, 940, 1300, {
        ...wide, seed: 41, reg: 14, cls: " malam", bs: "--a:96px;--c:64px;--l:26px",
        band: bandStats(["Chat 0812-3456-7890", "RP25RB", [["HARI", "SABTU 14 DES"], ["TEMPAT", "LAPANGAN GANG MAWAR"], ["ANAK", "GRATIS"]]]),
      });
      const q3 = squeegee(S3, 1030);
      tl.to(S3, { y: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: "power3.out", immediateRender: false }, 10.95);
      pull(q3, P3.el, 70, 200, 940, 1300, "d", 11.55, 0.5, "color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 24%, var(--teks))");
      tl.to(P3.inks, { x: 0, y: 0, duration: 0.12, ease: "power4.out", immediateRender: false }, 12.1);
      print(P3, 12.15);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
